content:
nora (sec-eng): We're seeing SCIM failures after last night's KMS alias update for tenant 'pioneer'. Users created but no RBAC roles applied. Error shows MALFORMED_CIPHERTEXT.

ben (infra): Confirmed. Alias moved to new key version at 22:40 UTC. Some envelopes still wrapped with old context schema. KMS unwrap rejects when encryptionContext doesn't match.

maya (devex): Example log: ```2026-03-22T22:55:12Z ERROR scim: unwrap tenant=pioneer user=uid-12 err=MALFORMED_CIPHERTEXT env=env-12```

nora (sec-eng): Mitigation suggestion: set tenant flag to skip strict role enforcement while we rewrap and backfill. Also redact any logs that included emails.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260322-99 created, severity=P2, assignees=@ben,@nora

ben (infra): Plan: 1) run controlled rewrap job: attempt legacy unwrap (no context) -> re-encrypt with v2 context; 2) backfill roles; 3) rotate any tokens found in logs; 4) add opt-in fallback to unwrap client for rotation window.

nora (sec-eng): Important: fallback must be auditable and tenant-scoped. Don't make it global.

maya (devex): I'll notify CS and draft customer note: short provisioning delay.

ben (infra): Running small staging batch now. If successful, will run prod rewrap at rate=150/s.

nora (sec-eng): Post-checks: prod rewrap finished, backfill applied, re-enabled RBAC at 23:30 UTC. No further MALFORMED_CIPHERTEXT seen.

incident-bot: INC-20260322-99 resolved.

maya (devex): Follow-ups: add migration step to rotation playbook, add encryptionContext schema version field, and add log sanitizer for PII.

nora (sec-eng): Filing a vuln ticket for stack traces leaking emails in 500s.
